candidates.description: These tokens represent German auxiliary and modal verbs used to express tense, mood, or necessity.
This feature vector activates strongly on common German grammatical words, including conjunctions, auxiliary verbs, and pronouns.
Common German modal particles and adverbial modifiers expressing nuance, emphasis, or qualification.
This vector represents short, rhyming monosyllabic exclamations or syllable fragments ending in "eh" or "ah".

This vector is related to common German prepositions, nouns, and word roots, particularly those starting with capitalized or lowercase prepositional and syllabic fragments like 'auf', 'durch', and 'für'.
German possessive determiners and pronouns inflected for various cases and genders.
These tokens are German inflected pronouns and determiners, primarily functioning in genitive and dative cases.
This feature vector activates on common German verb stems, prefixes, and morphological fragments.
These tokens represent German noun-forming suffixes and words containing them, specifically centered around the ubiquitous nominalizing suffix "-ung".
This vector represents common German third-person singular and plural present- and past-tense verb forms.
